thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INFERENCE_QUEUE_BACKLOG (region: us-west-2) — trigger: queue_depth > 10000, processing_lag > 30s. PD: https://pd.example/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident triggered -> INC12345. Notifying rotation.

alex k: acked. I'm on-call and looking now.

maria g: seeing sharp rise in 5xxs and request rejections. /api/generate 503 rate ~18% over last 5m. avg processing lag ~42s, queue depth ~12,400.

sanjay r: checked autoscaler logs, it attempted to request capacity but cloud API returned quota errors repeatedly:
```
ERROR 2026-10-05T14:12:31Z autoscaler: request_nodes failed: quotaExceeded: projects/compute-project-xyz has insufficient quota for region us-west-2
```
This explains why autoscaler didn't keep up.

eva (oncall): I'm going to spin up nodes manually in the dedicated pool and route traffic there. Starting now.

ken p: also suggest enabling temporary fallback model (small-quant) for noisy tenants to reduce per-token compute until we have capacity. I can flip feature flag.

alex k: manual scale applied to dedicated inference pool:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/dedicated-worker --replicas=40 --record
# aws: launching 20 c6i.xlarge nodes via infra-provisioner
```

incident-bot: Page acknowledged by alex k (on-call).

maria g: I've deployed a route rule to divert high-latency tenants to the dedicated pool and reduced concurrency for bulk requests. Command used:
```
curl -X POST https://config-api/internal/route -d '{"route": "dedicated-pool", "match": "tenant in (alpha,beta)"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer ${INTERNAL_TOKEN}"
```

sanjay r: running kvcache warmup for hot prefixes to reduce cold-start token overhead:
```
./tools/warmup_kv.sh --prefixes=prod_hot_prefixes --concurrency=8
```
Warmup started, should help throughput once workers register.

eva (oncall): nodes are coming up. kube nodes: 18 -> 35 in 6 minutes. pods scheduling, readiness checks passing, worker pool reported active 38 replicas. Queue depth dropping to 4.2k and processing lag to ~8s.

product-notify-bot: Notified affected customers (alpha, beta tenants) with templated message: "Experiencing degraded generation latency; mitigation in progress; expected recovery 10-20m."

ken p: good. We should create an autoscaler fallback: if cloud API returns quota errors for >2m, automatically trigger reserve-pool spinup and lower batch sizes. Filing follow-up.

alex k: monitoring shows backlog continuing to fall: 4.2k -> 900 over next 5m. 5xxs down to 1.2% (baseline ~0.8%).

maria g: confirming customer impact: external SLO alert matched for 3 tenants; no payment-critical customers impacted but some enterprise customers saw elevated errors. Recording in incident notes.

sanjay r: captured logs and stack traces to incident artifact: s3://redwood-incidents/INC12345/logs.tar.gz. Root cause appears to be quota exhaustion at cloud provider during a regional spin-up spike. Autoscaler retried but didn't surface fallback.

alex k: queue < 300 and all affected endpoints healthy. I'm closing the PagerDuty incident now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC12345 resolved by alex k. Duration ~18m.

maria g: postmortem action items:
- add runbook step: detect quotaExceeded in autoscaler and auto-trigger reserve-pool spinup (RN-2026).
- add alert to escalate to infra-team on quota errors >2m.
- add test to simulate quota failures in staging.

sanjay r: opened GH issue #RN-2026 with logs and proposed autoscaler fallback patch.

eva (oncall): leaving handoff notes in oncall doc and tagging next rotation. All good for now. :thumbsup:

product-notify-bot: Postmortem scheduled, will send summary to CSMs and leadership channel later today.

alex k: thanks all. closing thread.
